_comment: PRIMARY PATH: the installer composes this fragment into the managed PostToolUse hook automatically, on fresh install and on every --update (composePostToolUseHookCommand() in scripts/mavp-install.js reads this file's `fragment` field directly) — no manual editing needed for installer-managed projects; see docs/core/BOOTSTRAP_GUIDE.md — 'Claude Code hooks activation'. FALLBACK for non-installer setups: add this fragment to your project's PostToolUse hook whose matcher is "Edit|Write" in .claude/settings.local.json, after the file-path extraction step (the same $FP extraction used by templates/hardened-validator-hook.fragment.json and templates/doc-sync-hook.fragment.json). Runs scripts/mavp-manifest-guard.js against the edited/written file path so an unclassified new file surfaces as a stderr advisory at creation time instead of at publish-assembly time. Advisory only — always exits 0, never blocks the Edit/Write tool call, and is a no-op wherever scripts/mavp-manifest-guard.js is absent (adopter repos, public mirror).
protections: No-op guard — the leading `[ -f ... ] &&` check makes this fragment inert in any project without scripts/mavp-manifest-guard.js (adopter repos that never installed the manifest-guard script).

Canonical-gated — the guard script itself only advises when it detects the canonical private repo (every scripts/publish-manifest.json `exclude` key is git-tracked, per the heuristic in scripts/test-publish-overlay.js's Test 4). It is silent in the public mirror and every other adopter fork.
Never blocks — the guard script always exits 0. The trailing `|| true` is a second layer of the same guarantee: a PostToolUse hook fragment must never fail the tool call it's attached to.
Silent by default — the guard prints nothing unless it finds an unclassified new/tracked path; ordinary edits produce no output.
requires: scripts/mavp-manifest-guard.js from mavericks >= T-401; $FP already extracted earlier in the hook chain (see templates/hardened-validator-hook.fragment.json for the extraction snippet) and $MAVROOT pointing at the mavericks scripts directory the same way the hardened validator hook resolves it
commit_time_backstop: Pairs with .claude/hooks/pre-commit's `node scripts/check-publish-manifest.js --if-canonical` step (also T-401), which blocks the commit outright if this advisory was missed or ignored. The PostToolUse fragment here is the early, non-blocking signal; the pre-commit step is the last-resort blocking gate.
